text:
Ida: Quick intake — vendor submitted "copper-13b-v2" for onboarding. They attached a model card and a research-only clause. Can we host on hosted API?
Sam: tagging legal. @Leah — does research-only block Dedicated/private?
Leah: Research-only (NCU) blocks public hosted and self-serve. Dedicated or private might be OK if vendor signs a commercial / server-only addendum. Need to confirm redistribution & derivative clauses.
Jordan: FYI vendor's license has a "no derivative works" line in sec 4. That would prevent us from producing quantized artifacts or shipping weights.
Kai: If derivatives are disallowed we cannot provide quantized weight downloads or allow customers to export model files. We could still offer inference behind our private control plane if vendor allows server-only.
Leah: Action: ask vendor for (a) commercial license or server-only license terms, (b) explicit permission for quantization/weight transforms, (c) provenance of training data.
Ida: Also raise export-control check — double-check EAR/UK controls for >10B param models and any restricted datasets used.
Sam: Quick scan command I ran: `license-scan --model copper-13b-v2 --rules legal-gate --output json`
ops-bot: license-scan finished — findings: license: research-only-v1.0; contains bundled MIT-licensed tokenizer code; provenance: partially unknown (vendor did not list dataset subsets).
Leah: Draft intake checklist I'm going to add to the intake PR: 1) full license text & commercial permissions 2) derivatives / redistribution clause 3) training-data provenance & dataset licenses 4) export-control / jurisdiction guidance 5) safety evals (PII leakage, toxicity, jailbreak) 6) hosting constraints (no-hosting / private-only) 7) required contract addendum copy 8) allowed use cases list from vendor
Jordan: For eval scope (once license cleared): run safety suite vs veridian-7b baseline, run instruction-following eval, and quantify hallucination metrics on our prompt-set. Quantization plan: int8 + 4-bit per-channel test, measure perplexity and RLHF-style instruction adherence.
Kai: Prioritization note: If vendor accepts server-only license and quantization permission, mark as P1 for enterprise Private customers (they requested early access). If vendor refuses commercial terms, mark as research-only intake and close after internal eval.
Ida: I'll open the intake PR and ping vendor for answers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-intakes/pull/482
Sam: Adding legal ops and contracts to the intake. @Leah will you draft a short addendum template we can reuse? :thumbsup:
Leah: Yep — I'll post a draft in the PR and attach a redlined sample. Will include a clause that permits internal quantization/transforms and server-only hosting.
Ida: Thanks. If vendor agrees to addendum, schedule quantization bench on eng-ml cluster next Wednesday. If not, keep it to internal evaluation only and no hosting. :eyes:
